This week working with @RepDwightEvans, I reintroduced the Farmers Market and Food Bank Local Revitalization Act, legislation that provides nutrition security for seniors and families while supporting our local farmers, markets, and food banks. Think Local! https://t.co/IHt8SDo7Lj

Knowing how Heath could have benefited from the #PACTAct, I simply cannot stay quiet while the @HouseGOP try to dismantle and defund imperative veterans’ benefits like this as a tactic to cut costs. Cutting screening and treatment for our veterans isn’t a way to cut costs.

Ohio voters continue to show up to the polls during this critical special election. Early voting provides a great opportunity for every Ohioan to exercise their right to vote. Don’t forget to cast your ballot by mail or in person on or before August 8th! https://t.co/uPjgSjjlyh

Glad to host @SecGranholm today and discuss how we can modernize energy systems across NW Ohio. We toured the Toledo Wastewater Treatment facility, met with labor leaders involved in training workers for the future, and visited @Nature_Fresh Farms in Fulton County. https://t.co/nhpO0W1TGa

The 50th anniversary of WIC is a national milestone to celebrate. This lifeline links mothers and children to wholesome foods, fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, and local farmers to customers seeking better nutrition. Here’s to 50 more years of providing nutritious resources. https://t.co/vQoEMdCTlZ

On Triple Negative Breast Cancer Awareness Day we commit to fight this terrible disease — TNBC is an aggressive type of breast cancer, accounting for 15% of all breast cancers — it tends to grow and spread faster, has fewer treatment options, and tends to have a worse prognosis. https://t.co/JylMfcSO8B

This week @RepJeffries joined our NW Ohio health care community for a roundtable, where a constituent told us the story of her niece newly diagnosed with breast cancer. For 2 weeks she has been forced to delay treatment, squeezed between the sides of our broken insurance system. https://t.co/CUbDhTCU2A

Upgrades to the Wastewater Treatment Plant will improve operations and help contain costs for property owners. I applaud @FultonCounty_OH for taking initiative, thinking big, and collaborating with us on a project that will help serve the community for generations to come.

Reflecting on #InternationalWorkersDay, I'm filled with immense pride and gratitude for the hardworking individuals who make our communities thrive. Your dedication and passion inspire me every day. Let's continue to stand together for fair treatment and dignity in the workplace. https://t.co/UJaoB9Bzqa

This week we celebrate #NationalHealthCenterWeek. From primary care, to substance use treatment, and social services, community health centers treat the whole person. Receiving care in your community is essential. People deserve services and care that meets them where they are. https://t.co/73xE0gc0F3

Today marks the 59th Anniversary of President Lyndon B. Johnson signing the Voting Rights Act of 1965 into law. This pivotal moment in our nation's history assured that every American can exercise their sacred right to vote. We must always fight to defend this essential freedom. https://t.co/pUKWjsA5GD
